messages:
maya: Quick sync — PR #4587 introduces a 'Latency heatmap' dashboard and a new Go SDK snippet for trace+cost breakdown. I noticed the dashboard guide links to d3js.org v3 (404) and the Go snippet uses old header `X-Trace-Id` instead of `traceparent`. Need someone to own the small migration and link patch. Also want a tiny example that shows cost-per-route vs latency percentiles. @tony can you check the dashboard YAML?

ton y: looking now. failing link — yep d3 v3 removed that page. I can update to d3 v7 CDN, but need to confirm we want to keep the custom viz or switch to a simple histogram using our console's heatmap component. cc @samira for UX.

samira: I'd prefer the native console component for consistency. If we switch, we need one short example and remove the external js. can we keep an embed sample + screenshot?

kevin: I can rework the Go snippet to use `traceparent` and add minimal cost annotation example. quick diff: ```go
req.Header.Set("traceparent", tp)
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Cost-Units", fmt.Sprint(costUnits))
``` will be enough.

maya: awesome. two action items: 1) tony replace external d3 link with console heatmap example + screenshot 2) kevin update go snippet and add line about RFC7541 trace header and link to our tracehook docs. I'll open a docs follow-up PR to remove dead d3 guide. timeline: can we have edits by EOD tomorrow? :calendar:

tony: should be able to do today. will push small change to the PR and drop the external script; adding screenshot asset `assets/heatmap-quick.png` — samira ok to own screenshot?

samira: yep i'll take screenshot and upload. any copy edits for the caption? propose: 'Latency heatmap (Console native) — p50/p90/p99 by route over 24h'

kevin: pushed snippet branch, but needs review. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4591 - includes header update + short unit example. i left a TODO to add a test run. @maya can you add a test checklist item so we don't forget to smoke the example?

maya: added checklist comment in PR. docs-bot: reminder: 'Small PRs that change examples need a smoke test and an asset license check.'

docs-bot: note: assets/heatmap-quick.png size <= 1MB and licensed under CC-BY? please confirm.

samira: screenshot created, optimized, CC-BY and uploaded to PR branch.

tony: merged link fix and screenshot; left changelog entry. moving PR back to maya for final copy check.

maya: will review tonight. if no objections, I'll merge tomorrow morning. final note: update release notes under 'Observability docs' and ping #all-hands snippets channel after merge. thanks team :rocket:
